Healthy Chicken Stroganoff
one pot recipe | healthier version of your favorite recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 13 | F: 13 | P: 54
Calories: 390 per serving | 550 with regular pasta
Serves 3 OR 4 people 

Ingredients
450 grams chicken breast, cut into pieces, sizes as per your preference 
1/2 tsp salt
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp garlic oil OR 1 tsp oil with 2 tsp minced garlic 
1 onion, finely sliced
1 packet button mushroom
2 tbsp WC Sauce
1 tbsp dijon mustard OR 2 tbsp if using that generic mustard
1  cups vegetable OR chicken stock, use water if you dont have
1 cup greek yogurt 
160 grams pasta, any works here or you can serve with steamed rice
45 grams of uncooked pasta per serving 

Method: 
add the garlic oil to the pan along with the onions, cook till translucent 
add in the mushrooms cook till water evaporates
take the mix out and add in the chicken to the pan along with salt and pepper, cook till almost done and add in the cooked onions and mushroom
add in WC Sauce and Dijon mustard next along with the stock/water
allow to cook for 2-3 minutes
TURN OFF THE HEAT and add in the greek yogurt and mix it together till combined
start the flame on low and allow to simmer for a few minutes
your stroganoff is ready to serve :) 

TIPS:
you can further improve the nutrition of the dishes by using a high protein or quinoa type pasta
if using a good non stick pan, you can avoid the oil in both pasrts of the recipe 
a light sprinkle of parmesan or cheddar tastes great but isnt needed. this recipe is super creamy
